fieldValues.title: A source document's content checksum is stored nowhere
fieldValues.summary: srs attachment add computes and reports contentChecksum and sidecarChecksum, but neither is persisted: the sidecar schema has no checksum property and the index that held them was retired, so nothing records which bytes an attached transcript had.
evidence: grep for the reported digest in the minutes repository: no match
docs/schema/2.0/source-document-meta.json: no checksum property; srs-spec.md Source documents still describes manifest.sourceDocumentIndex
fieldValues.body: Provenance is weakest exactly where the evidence is a file. Carriers work around it by checksumming the whole archive.
